g.title: W1
g.text: OLED branch. Length terminal-to-terminal, tol +/-5 mm.

g.title: W2
g.text: Sensor branch. Length terminal-to-terminal, tol +/-5 mm.

g.title: X_OLED
g.text: 4 x Crimp terminal, DuPont 2.54 female, 22-28 AWG

g.title: label_notes
g.text: 1. Wire 28 AWG UL1571 (OD 0.8-1.0 mm to suit SZH-002T-P0.5). Length 50 +/-5 mm, terminal to terminal.
2. Wires loose, no sleeve. Each branch may be lightly twisted.
3. OLED header order GND-VCC-SCL-SDA (GME12864-11). Match the module silkscreen.
4. Sensor: Sharp GP2Y0A51SK0F, ZH 3-pin Vo-GND-Vcc per the Sharp datasheet.
5. Battery not in this harness: 702035 cell with its own leads and a JST PH 2.0 2P plug (PHR-2) to J6. J6 pin 1 VBAT+, pin 2 GND.
6. 100% continuity test; pull test per JST spec.
